description: Profile based on an uploaded in-game WWE 2K26 mask_color texture. This item behaves like a flat UV/cutout luchador mask texture with separate islands, lacing borders, a lower front bib panel, and side mask islands. Use this profile for cutout-style mask items, not continuous hood-wrap items.

logic_grid.range_rule: Column and row ranges are inclusive logical ranges.
logic_grid.notes: 128 x 128 normalized lmask-layout grid. Each cell is exactly 16 px on a 2048 x 2048 texture.

upper_center_cap_top_crown.purpose: Actual tan top/crown cap and upper center fold area

main_front_safe_area.purpose: Compatibility alias for main visible front design area on cutout mask profile.

left_eye_surround.purpose: Compatibility alias for left eye/wing zone.

right_eye_surround.purpose: Compatibility alias for right eye/wing zone.

chin_lower_mouth.purpose: Compatibility alias for mouth/logo/chin plate zone.

left_side_wrap.purpose: Compatibility alias for left side cutout island.

right_side_wrap.purpose: Compatibility alias for right side cutout island.

top_crown.purpose: Compatibility alias for actual upper-center cap/crown zone.

bottom_neck_transition.purpose: Compatibility alias for lower front/bib panel, not a normal hood neck band.

must: Treat this as a flat UV/cutout-style luchador mask texture, not a continuous hood wrap.
Preserve the central front face design inside central_front_design_safe.
Keep major eye/forehead identity inside the eye and forehead zones.
Treat the lower_front_bib_panel as its own large lower front design area.
Use far-left and far-right side islands for side mask artwork.
Keep lacing/hole border zones clean and do not cover them with important logos.
Use the diagonal strap zones for broad color flow and material pattern continuity.
Use 2048 x 2048 as the default production canvas unless another size is explicitly selected.
Use the 128 x 128 layout/grid references for placement accuracy.
Do not copy guide colors, labels, or grid lines into final mask_color.png.
avoid: Do not use generic_hood_wrap_v1 for this item.
Do not place critical artwork in the far edge seams unless mirroring is intended.
Do not paint over lace holes or edge hardware with important details.
Do not treat the full top rows as one continuous crown zone.

source_reference: Profile layout reference for compatible user-supplied mask textures.

coordinate_rules.clamp_rule: Clamp final end values to canvasSize - 1 so calculated pixels never exceed canvas bounds.

layout_reference_usage: Upload the layout reference PNG with the final handoff prompt and profile JSON. It is a placement guide only, not final art. Use the 128 x 128 technical grid for exact placement correction; each cell is 16 px on a 2048 texture.
